Note that the proof of Lemma 5.11 only relies on the $\mathscr{S}$ -constructibility of $\mathscr{F}$, and not on its ${G_{\mathcal{O}}}$ -equivariance; in particular, this proof is independent of Corollary 4.8. (This fact does not play any role in the present case when $\mathbf{k}$ is a field of characteristic $0$, but will be important in the case of general coefficients considered in Part II.)

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
